# **Brocumber**

Genre: Roguelike survival · Arena combat · Shop-based upgrades

Brocumber is a survival game inspired by Brotato. Players choose a character, fight waves of enemies, collect coins, purchase weapons, and build increasingly powerful combinations through a reroll-based shop system.

## **1\. Core gameplay**

* Character selection: Choose from 25 characters, each with unique abilities, advantages, and disadvantages.  
* Arena combat: Survive waves of enemies using weapons and character-specific powers.  
* Weapon shop: Spend coins to buy weapons and reroll the shop for different options.  
* Build customization: Combine weapons and upgrades to create different playstyles.  
* Character restrictions: Some characters can use only specific weapon categories or have special equipment rules.  
* Survival: Manage health, damage, armor, and other stats to survive increasingly challenging encounters.

## **2\. Base character stats**

| Stat | Starting value |
| ----- | ----- |
| Health (HP) | 15 |
| Melee damage bonus | 0 |
| Ranged damage bonus | 0 |
| Speed bonus | 0 |
| Armor bonus | 0 |
| Luck bonus | 0 |

All stats affected by upgrades start at zero unless a character has a specific starting bonus or penalty. Health starts at 15 before character modifiers.

## **3\. Weapon system**

Brocumber features melee, ranged, medieval, gun, miscellaneous, and sports weapons. Each weapon has a damage value and a reload interval that determines how frequently it can attack.

## **4\. Character roster**

Brocumber will feature 25 playable characters. Each character has a unique playstyle, with certain characters trading flexibility for powerful bonuses or special abilities.

### **Standard characters**

1\. Normal

No special bonuses or penalties. This is the default character and provides a balanced starting experience.

2\. Ranger

Can equip ranged weapons only. Designed for players who prefer attacking from a distance.

3\. Brawler

Can equip melee weapons only. Designed for close-range combat.

4\. Well-Rounded

Gains \+3 melee damage and \+3 ranged damage.

### **Stat-based characters**

| Character | Bonuses | Penalties / special rules |
| ----- | ----- | ----- |
| Crazy | \+50 damage, \+50 HP | −200 luck, −20 armor |
| Old | −63% enemies, \+21 HP | Enemies deal more damage; −50 damage |
| Young | \+63% enemies, \+100 damage, \+43 HP, \+43 armor | −20 damage for every ranged weapon equipped |
| Baby | −50% enemies | No other modifiers specified |
| Jockey | \+23 armor, \+23 speed | None specified |
| Graduate Student | \+30 HP | None specified |
| Teen | \+100 speed, \+15 HP | −30 damage |

Design note: “Old” and “Young” need a precise definition for how enemy damage changes. For Young, the ranged-weapon penalty should be clarified as either a reduction to total damage or a reduction to each weapon's damage.

### **Weapon-restricted characters**

| Character | Special rule |
| ----- | ----- |
| Robot | Can equip the drill only; \+20 armor and \+15 damage; cannot heal during a round. |
| Soldier | Can equip guns only; −15 damage; loses 10 HP for every pair of identical weapons equipped. |
| King | Can equip medieval weapons only. |
| Athlete | Can equip sports weapons only. |
| Prince | Can equip the wand only. |
| Princess | Can equip the wand only. |

### **Special-ability characters**

| Character | Ability |
| ----- | ----- |
| Mom | Spawns up to 8 baby companions that fight for the player and equip the same item the player has. −30 damage. |
| God | \+100 HP; loses 20 HP for every gun equipped. |
| Bounty Hunter | Earns \+0.1 coins for every enemy killed. |
| Dog | Cannot equip weapons; can bite enemies; \+10 HP and \+10 damage. |
| Cat | Cannot equip weapons; can bite enemies; \+10 HP and \+10 damage. |
| Inventor | Can summon a mini-robot companion that fights alongside the player and can be destroyed under certain conditions. Can upgrade the robot's stats. |
| Shapeshifter | Can transform into a cat or dog, gaining the corresponding form's abilities. |
| Guardian | Starts with 10 HP, cannot upgrade maximum health, and has 4 extra lives. |

## **5\. Character appearance**

7

* Main body: Green cucumber.  
* Shape: Short, rounded, and slightly cylindrical.  
* Approximate size: 15 × 15 pixels, suitable for a small pixel-art sprite.  
* Map will be 600x600   
* Face: Simple eyes and a mouth with clear expressions.  
* Style: Simple, colorful, and recognizable during fast-paced combat.  
* Customization: Different accessories, facial expressions, and small details can distinguish characters without changing the core design.

## **6\. Recommended shop and upgrade system**

* Shop: Displays a selection of weapons and upgrades after a wave.  
* Reroll: Spend coins to replace the current selection with new options.  
* Weapon limits: Set a maximum number of equipped weapons so inventory decisions matter.  
* Character restrictions: The shop should respect weapon restrictions where possible, or clearly indicate when a weapon cannot be equipped.  
* Upgrades: Improve stats such as health, damage, armor, speed, and luck.  
* Scaling difficulty: Enemies become more challenging as the player progresses.  
* Companions: Characters such as Mom and Inventor receive their own companion behavior and upgrade rules.
